name: Moroccan-Spiced Roasted Kabocha & Butternut Squash with Chickpeas (Night 1)
whyItWorks: Peeled roasted kabocha and butternut squash flesh is rich in soothing soluble fiber, provided you leave the whole chickpeas and nuts behind.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat only the soft orange kabocha and butternut squash flesh (leave the skin, whole chickpeas, and any dried fruit/nuts on the plate).
